scope: IC-only u=u0+t*N; no embedded speed or future radius/profile; same PDE/graph and matched 2000-step budget. Three paired seeds plus one curriculum.
limitations: Fixed spatial graph accuracy; no continuous-PDE spatial convergence claim.
Short pilots for one initial condition and parameter set; no general solver guarantee.
Hard IC is prescribed data and tanh is a bounded representation; neither specifies subsequent motion.
Count-based ice volume and near-axis interpolation are same-grid diagnostics.
